problems: Cliopatria 'Sultanate of Malacca' 1529..1861: eleven shapes are not Malacca (the sultanate ended 1528); they are verdict wrong. The 1459 shape lies on Singapore/Riau, not Malacca town, and is inside Cliopatria's Majapahit shape; the Majapahit dossier owner should check Majapahit's 1459-1474 shape.

Cliopatria 'Sultanate of Sulu' 1748+ contains Cliopatria's Kingdom of Bulungan cells (Bulungan row 1734..1747); the Bulungan page makes Bulungan a Sulu vassal 1789-1855 only. Cliopatria's 'Sultanate of Cirebon' 1579+ contains Cliopatria's last Sunda Kingdom shape (83 cells). The se-03 owner of kingdom-of-bulungan and the se-02 owner of sunda-kingdom should know.
Cliopatria 'Kingdom of Pajana' 1572..1587 repeats Demak's 1519 shape cell for cell; nothing covers 1569-1571 (Demak ends 1568 on the page).

Vassal tints that belong to other ledgers: Sulu under Brunei 1457-1578 (sultanate-of-brunei), Sulu under Spain from 1851 (spanish-empire), Demak under Majapahit 1475-1478 (majapahit), Cirebon under Mataram from 1595 and under the Dutch after 1680 (mataram-sultanate, Dutch dossiers); Majapahit's matching loss of Indragiri, Jambi, Tungkal and Siantan to Malacca (Mansur's reign 1459-1477).

Banten's status is claimed by both Cirebon (Banten page: de jure province of Cirebon 1526-1552; recorded in sultanate-of-cirebon) and Demak (Demak page: a vassal sultanate); the Banten dossier should reconcile. The Sunda Kalapa conquest of 1527 is recorded in Demak only as a contest 1527-1531.
